translations.web: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.” ’
translations.bsb: So I asked them: ‘What is this high place to which you go?’ (And to this day it is called Bamah.)
translations.kjv: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
translations.asv: Then I said unto them, What meaneth the high place whereunto ye go? So the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
